measurement.name: Somali Current
measurement.range_interpretation: One seasonal regional prose span, not an annual range, probability interval or three monthly measurements. Other months have no compatible width evidence here.
measurement.geographic_scope: Northern Somali coastal upwelling regime, farther north than the southern EACC extension that turns offshore near 3-4 N. Northern latitude limits unresolved; no width assigned to the southern gyre, Great Whirl or the entire Somali Current.
measurement.section_orientation: No reproducible section endpoints extracted from the original review prose.
measurement.layer: Shallow northward coastal flow overlying a southward undercurrent; no numerical fixed layer or velocity threshold extracted for the width.
measurement.time_convention: March-May seasonal synthesis in the 2001 review; no specific year, exact occupied section dates or monthly width values supplied.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported order-of-magnitude width scale of the northern shallow coastal flow. Paired geographic edges and a speed cutoff are unextracted.
measurement.source_citation: Schott, F. A. and McCreary, J. P. Jr. (2001), The monsoon circulation of the Indian Ocean, Progress in Oceanography 51, 1-123, doi:10.1016/S0079-6611(01)00083-0.
measurement.source_locator: Section 4.1.1, printed p. 38 (PDF page 38), March-May paragraph, final sentence and preceding northern-flow context.
measurement.extraction_method: Numerical seasonal width scale transcribed from inspected full original prose; no contour, section or raw observation digitization.
remaining_gates: Recover underlying dated northern coastal sections and boundary convention.
Obtain compatible repeat widths across the other nine months before a yearly cycle.
measurement.source_quality_note: Full original review inspected and printed p. 38 rendered. This is a seasonal synthesis; underlying width occupations and boundary methods remain unextracted.
measurement.calendar_source_locator: Section 4.1.1, printed p. 38 (PDF page 38), March-May paragraph heading.
